Build phase 4.8 · why it looks like this

Three layers,
one cited answer.

The palette is NCBI's own, so it is not where the identity comes from. The identity comes from something no other answer engine has: every claim on screen carries the data layer it came from, in colour, everywhere.

Open the prototype This page is the reasoning. The prototype is the product.

The identity

The data layer is the design system

Every answer is assembled from three places: the knowledge graph System 1 and 2 ingest, live NCBI APIs, and the enrichment APIs. Giving each one a colour turns an implementation detail into the thing people recognise.

It earns its place because it is true rather than decorative. The colour on a citation tells a reader where the fact came from, and therefore how fresh it is and how it was established. A curated graph assertion and a literature co-mention are not the same kind of claim, and the interface should not pretend otherwise.

Knowledge graph#205493
A periodic snapshot. Broad and fast.
Live NCBI#2E8540
Fetched as you ask. Narrow and current.
Enrichment#4C2C92
Literature and trials, layered on top.

Red is deliberately absent from that set. It is reserved for the risk tier and for refusals, so a high-risk clinical claim never has to compete with a layer colour for the same meaning. It is the only red in the product.

Three choices, settled 2026-08-12

Where the boldness was spent

Every other decision in this system is restrained so that these three can carry the work.

The provenance spine

A segmented vertical track beside the answer, one segment per claim, coloured by the layer that backed it. Borrowed from genome browser tracks, so the form is native to the audience. It encodes real data rather than decorating: a grey segment means an uncited claim, visible before a word is read.

It renders always, not only when something is wrong. A track that appears solely on failure is unexplained noise at exactly the moment precision matters most.

Kept, always rendered

One saturated surface

The landing sits on NCBI navy at full strength. Everything else is flat white on a tinted canvas with hairline borders and no shadows anywhere, so cards read as documents rather than app furniture.

This phase exists because the shipped interface was too unstyled to demo, and an all-white landing risks returning to precisely that. Spending the whole boldness budget in one place buys presence at no cost to institutional credibility.

Kept

Monospace, narrowed

Monospace marks a string you transcribe exactly: accessions, rsIDs, concept ids, predicate names, tool names, dates, record URLs. It is the one typographic rule doing real work, because those are things a researcher copies and compares character by character.

Gene symbols were removed from the rule. BRCA1 inside a sentence is read as a word, and three typeface switches in three sentences breaks the line rhythm for no informational gain. The test is not "is this biomedical" but "would someone compare this character by character".

Kept, narrowed

Where things live

This page is not the design

It holds the reasoning and nothing else, on purpose. Everything that can be shown rather than argued lives somewhere it cannot drift.

The four artifacts

  • The prototype, design-system/prototype/app.html. The whole product, clickable. Play with it, show it to people.
  • The component cards, design-system/. Eighteen isolated cards. Builders build from these and the premise gate asserts against them, so these are the only ones not allowed to go stale.
  • This page. The argument. Allowed to lag, because nothing is checked against it.
  • The workflow, Design_to_build_workflow.md. How a design change travels from Claude Design into React code, and what it costs before versus after the phase opens.

What this is betting on

That the most persuasive thing this product can show a room is not a nicer search box. It is watching a question cross three data layers in eleven seconds and come back with every sentence traceable to an NCBI record.

  • The palette is not the identity. NCBI's colours are the ground everyone in this space stands on. The layer system is what makes the page ours.
  • Flat is a choice, not a shortcut. No shadows on data surfaces. Depth comes from the tinted canvas and one saturated navy.
  • Motion only where it means something. The pipeline animates because it is genuinely happening. Nothing else moves.
  • Every decoration is data. Chip colour is the layer. Spine segments are claims. The dots are the allowance. Remove the meaning and the ornament goes with it.
